name: Hypetrix (Hysense)
name_zh: 深圳超维传感科技有限公司
summary: Hypetrix, also identified as Hysense, is the tactile-sensing brand presented by Shenzhen Chaowei Sensing Technology Co., Ltd. It develops fingertip and finger-pad tactile sensors, thin-film pressure arrays and tactile data-collection gloves for dexterous hands, robot skin and manipulation research.
